heading: Transferability

chapter.title: DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE RECOGNISED STOCK EXCHANGE(S)

content:
93. The recognised stock exchange(s) shall coordinate with Depositories to ensure
compliance with the applicable laws or directions of the Board or any competent court
with regard to freezing / unfreezing, lock-in/ release of lock-in with respect to securities
issued or managed by the listed entity.
